title: AlmostGM
tagline: app which has a button for posting gm on Lens and that tracks gm count
description: Our project is an app which has a button for posting a gm post on Lens protocol and that tracks gm count of the poster meaning how many gms the lens profile has posted over time. Unfortunately we did not manage to finish a gui and connect different functions to one another. There are no other features in our project submission.
how_its_made: We use hardhat as our ethereum development environment. Besides that we use lens protocol smart contracts directly. We call the smart contract to post a gm and calculate number of posts a Lens profile has made that contains "gm" in them.  Unfortunately we did not manage to finish a gui
